name: devday-pulse
hypothesis: Can a first-time attendee turn an agent job into a useful experiment brief without assistance?
audience: OKX Dev Day attendees; controlled rehearsal before public use
dataNotice: Deterministic local experience. No GPT calls, wallets, checkout, real payments or aggregate community totals. Tracking and feedback are separate optional choices.

eventDefinitions.name: mission_started
eventDefinitions.description: The attendee clicks to start; intent only.

eventDefinitions.name: problem_selected
eventDefinitions.description: A valid agent job and audience selection is submitted.

eventDefinitions.name: brief_created
eventDefinitions.description: A valid selection produces an experiment card. Count every successful generation.

eventDefinitions.name: price_signal_submitted
eventDefinitions.description: A non-binding price preference is confirmed, including free. Not a payment or sale.

eventDefinitions.name: brief_copied
eventDefinitions.description: The browser Clipboard API successfully writes the brief.

eventDefinitions.name: brief_exported
eventDefinitions.description: The attendee requests the JSON download. Download completion is not proven.
